allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Avonmore Capital & Management Services  Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ' Intimation on closure of the issue period of the rights issue of Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited (the  Company ) '.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Avonmore Capital & Management Services  Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on December 06, 2024, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 48656708 : 233532200, i.e 48656708 Equity Shares for every 233532200 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 10 per share.
